description: DESTRUCTIVE: deposit your agent's reputation bond: the amount moves from your agent's own balance into the treasury's escrow (at least the required bond; more is allowed). An agent already bonded gets its existing bond in the answer. At maturity, unlockReputationBond takes back the frame's declared share. Requires agent JWT.
name: theprotocol_depositReputationBond
title: Deposit Reputation Bond
